subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should the remaining TUI work be docs/help for the current pi-tui behavior only, or should OpenClaw expose a supported configurable send/newline keybinding surface for openclaw tui?
rationale: Current main already supports newline insertion through pi-tui, but a configurable preference would add public TUI config or CLI API surface under repository policy that sets a high bar for new config options.

options.title: Document Current Behavior
options.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Define a narrow keybinding config or CLI surface with docs and tests for default and customized send/newline behavior.

options.title: Route Broader Composer Work Elsewhere
options.body: Keep this issue focused on TUI inline composition and leave WebChat shortcuts, external-editor compose mode, and vi-mode to their existing related issues.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior
recommendation.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has already reviewed this exact issue and has the strongest current TUI docs, command, and editor-wrapper history signal.
